summary.text: Curt VanderWall is the Republican state representative for Michigan House District 102, which he has held since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Michigan House from 2017 to 2019 and in the state Senate from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Curt VanderWall's career experience includes owning Turf Care Mole Man, according to Ballotpedia.
He has served on the board of Old Kent Bank, the Mason County Growth Alliance Board and the Mason County Housing Board.
VanderWall represented Michigan House District 101 from 2017 to 2019, and Jack O'Malley succeeded him there.
He then served in Michigan Senate District 35 from 2019 to 2023, and returned to the House in District 102 in 2023, succeeding Michele Hoitenga.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Government Operations, Financial Services, Health Policy (as chair) and Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation committees.
